integrity: Original analytic local-exponential calculation; exact-rational chamber checks corroborate finite cases only. The directed-length covariance is prior-derivable background rather than a claimed novel component.
limitations: Geodesic circle; iid uniform points; integer n>=5.
No nonuniform, interval-boundary, higher-dimensional, or alternate power-weight theorem.
Potential unobserved equivalent older multivariate graph enumeration.
title: Opposite count–length correlations in circular nearest-neighbor networks
